actions.description: Crawl multiple URLs starting from a base URL and extract content.
actions.name: crawl

properties.description: The base URL to start crawling from.
properties.label: URL
properties.name: url

properties.description: Output formats to include in the response for each crawled page.
properties.label: Formats
properties.name: formats

properties.description: A natural language prompt to generate crawler options. Explicitly set parameters will override the generated equivalents.
properties.label: Prompt
properties.name: prompt

properties.description: URL pathname regex patterns that exclude matching URLs from the crawl.
properties.label: Exclude Paths
properties.name: excludePaths

properties.description: URL pathname regex patterns that include matching URLs in the crawl. Only paths matching the specified patterns will be included.
properties.label: Include Paths
properties.name: includePaths

properties.description: Maximum depth to crawl based on discovery order. The root site and sitemapped pages have a discovery depth of 0.
properties.label: Max Discovery Depth
properties.name: maxDiscoveryDepth

properties.description: Sitemap mode: 'include' uses sitemap and other methods (default), 'skip' ignores the sitemap, 'only' crawls only sitemap URLs.
properties.label: Sitemap
properties.name: sitemap

properties.description: Maximum number of pages to crawl. Default limit is 10000.
properties.label: Limit
properties.name: limit

properties.description: Options for scraping each page during the crawl.
properties.label: Scrape Options
properties.name: scrapeOptions

properties.description: Only return the main content excluding headers, navs, footers, etc.
properties.label: Only Main Content
properties.name: onlyMainContent

properties.description: HTML tags to include in the output.
properties.label: Include Tags
properties.name: includeTags

properties.description: HTML tags to exclude from the output.
properties.label: Exclude Tags
properties.name: excludeTags

properties.description: Returns a cached version if younger than this age in milliseconds. Default is 2 days (172800000ms).
properties.label: Max Age
properties.name: maxAge

properties.description: Custom headers to send with the request (e.g., cookies, user-agent).
properties.label: Headers
properties.name: headers

properties.description: Delay in milliseconds before fetching content.
properties.label: Wait For
properties.name: waitFor

properties.description: Emulate scraping from a mobile device.
properties.label: Mobile
properties.name: mobile

properties.description: Skip TLS certificate verification when making requests.
properties.label: Skip TLS Verification
properties.name: skipTlsVerification

properties.description: Timeout in milliseconds for the request. Maximum is 300000 (5 minutes).
properties.label: Timeout
properties.name: timeout

properties.description: Removes all base64 images from output.
properties.label: Remove Base64 Images
properties.name: removeBase64Images

properties.description: Enables ad-blocking and cookie popup blocking.
properties.label: Block Ads
properties.name: blockAds

properties.description: Proxy type: 'basic' (fast, basic anti-bot), 'enhanced' (slower, advanced anti-bot, costs up to 5 credits), 'auto' (retries with enhanced if basic fails).
properties.label: Proxy
properties.name: proxy

properties.description: Location settings for the request. Uses appropriate proxy and emulates language/timezone.
properties.label: Location
properties.name: location

properties.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., 'US', 'AU', 'DE', 'JP').
properties.label: Country
properties.name: country

properties.description: Preferred languages in order of priority (e.g., ['en-US', 'en']).
properties.label: Languages
properties.name: languages

properties.description: Controls how files are processed. When 'pdf' is included (default), PDF content is extracted and converted to markdown (1 credit per page).
Maximum number of PDF pages to parse (1-10000).
properties.label: Max Pages
properties.name: maxPages

properties.label: Parsers
properties.name: parsers

properties.description: If true, pages will be stored in Firecrawl index and cache. Set to false for data protection concerns.
properties.label: Store in Cache
properties.name: storeInCache

properties.description: Do not re-scrape the same path with different (or none) query parameters.
properties.label: Ignore Query Parameters
properties.name: ignoreQueryParameters

properties.description: When true, includePaths and excludePaths patterns are matched against the full URL including query parameters.
properties.label: Regex on Full URL
properties.name: regexOnFullURL

properties.description: Allows the crawler to follow internal links to sibling or parent URLs, not just child paths.
properties.label: Crawl Entire Domain
properties.name: crawlEntireDomain

properties.description: Allows the crawler to follow links to external websites.
properties.label: Allow External Links
properties.name: allowExternalLinks

properties.description: Allows the crawler to follow links to subdomains of the main domain.
properties.label: Allow Subdomains
properties.name: allowSubdomains

properties.description: Delay in seconds between scrapes. Helps respect website rate limits.
properties.label: Delay
properties.name: delay

properties.description: Maximum number of concurrent scrapes. If not specified, adheres to your team's concurrency limit.
properties.label: Max Concurrency
properties.name: maxConcurrency

properties.description: Webhook configuration to receive crawl status updates.
properties.label: Webhook
properties.name: webhook

properties.description: The URL to send webhook events to. Triggers for crawl.started, crawl.page, crawl.completed, and crawl.failed events.
properties.label: URL
properties.name: url

properties.description: Headers to send to the webhook URL.
properties.label: Headers
properties.name: headers

properties.description: Custom metadata included in all webhook payloads for this crawl.
properties.label: Metadata
properties.name: metadata

properties.description: Types of events to send to the webhook. Defaults to all events.
properties.label: Events
properties.name: events

properties.description: Enable zero data retention for this crawl. Contact help@firecrawl.dev to enable this feature.
properties.label: Zero Data Retention
properties.name: zeroDataRetention

actions.description: Map multiple URLs from a website based on specified options.
actions.name: map

properties.description: The base URL to start mapping from.
properties.label: URL
properties.name: url

properties.description: Specify a search query to order the results by relevance. Example: 'blog' will return URLs that contain the word 'blog' in the URL ordered by relevance.
properties.label: Search
properties.name: search

properties.description: Sitemap mode when mapping. If you set it to 'skip', the sitemap won't be used to find URLs. If you set it to 'only', only URLs that are in the sitemap will be returned. By default ('include'), the sitemap and other methods will be used together to find URLs.
properties.label: Sitemap
properties.name: sitemap

properties.description: Include subdomains of the website.
properties.label: Include Subdomains
properties.name: includeSubdomains

properties.description: Do not return URLs with query parameters.
properties.label: Ignore Query Parameters
properties.name: ignoreQueryParameters

properties.description: Bypass the sitemap cache to retrieve fresh URLs. Sitemap data is cached for up to 7 days; use this parameter when your sitemap has been recently updated.
properties.label: Ignore Cache
properties.name: ignoreCache

properties.description: Maximum number of links to return (1-100000).
properties.label: Limit
properties.name: limit

properties.description: Timeout in milliseconds. There is no timeout by default.
properties.label: Timeout
properties.name: timeout

properties.description: Location settings for the request. When specified, this will use an appropriate proxy if available and emulate the corresponding language and timezone settings. Defaults to 'US' if not specified.
properties.label: Location
properties.name: location

properties.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., 'US', 'AU', 'DE', 'JP').
properties.label: Country
properties.name: country

properties.description: Preferred languages and locales for the request in order of priority. Defaults to the language of the specified location.
properties.label: Languages
properties.name: languages

properties.description: Skip TLS certificate verification when making requests.

properties.description: Timeout in milliseconds for the request. Default is 30000 (30 seconds). Maximum is 300000 (5 minutes).

properties.description: Removes all base64 images from output. Image alt text remains but URL is replaced with placeholder.

properties.description: Enables ad-blocking and cookie popup blocking.

properties.description: Proxy type: 'basic' (fast, basic anti-bot), 'enhanced' (slower, advanced anti-bot, costs up to 5 credits), 'auto' (retries with enhanced if basic fails).

properties.description: Location settings for the request. Uses appropriate proxy and emulates language/timezone.

properties.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., 'US', 'AU', 'DE', 'JP').
properties.label: Country

properties.description: Preferred languages in order of priority (e.g., ['en-US', 'en']).
properties.label: Languages
properties.name: languages

properties.description: Controls how files are processed. When 'pdf' is included (default), PDF content is extracted and converted to markdown (1 credit per page). Empty array returns PDF in base64 (1 credit flat).
Maximum number of PDF pages to parse (1-10000).
properties.label: Max Pages
properties.name: maxPages

properties.label: Parsers

properties.description: If true, page will be stored in Firecrawl index and cache. Set to false for data protection concerns.
